description: Configuration for the netcoredbg debug adapter (.NET / F#).

request.description: Launch a new .NET process or attach to a running one.

program.description: Path to the managed assembly (.dll) to debug, e.g. bin/Debug/net8.0/App.dll.

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the program.

stopAtEntry.description: Break at the program entry point.

processId.description: Process id to attach to (attach request only). Use "$ZED_PICK_PID" to choose from a process picker at session start.

justMyCode.description: Only step through user code, skipping framework internals.
